# [Insert Your Paper Title Here]

[![arXiv](https://img.shields.io/badge/arXiv-2608.15161-b31b1b.svg)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15161)

This repository contains the code and data to reproduce the results presented in our manuscript. 

## Repository Contents

*   `algorithm_data.ipynb` - Jupyter notebook used to run the simulations and generate the data.
*   `plot.ipynb` - Jupyter notebook used to process the simulation data and generate the figures.
*   `simulation_data.npz` - Raw data collected from 10 random trials (generated by `algorithm_data.ipynb`).
*   `qsp_numerical_scaling.pdf` - The final exported figure as it appears in the manuscript (generated by `plot.ipynb`).

## Usage

To reproduce the figure from the paper, run the notebooks in the following order:

1.  *(Optional)* Run `algorithm_data.ipynb` to regenerate `simulation_data.npz` from scratch.
2.  Run `plot.ipynb` to read the `.npz` file and output the `qsp_numerical_scaling.pdf` figure.

## Dependencies
*   Python 3.x
*   Jupyter
*   NumPy
*   Matplotlib
